setup: Before this agreement: an open-ended vault, 200 XRP lender deposit, loan broker and 20 XRP first-loss cover.

scenes.title: Agree before moving money
scenes.copy: Exact loan terms are fixed. Both parties approve the transaction. The agreement fingerprint is sealed before signing.

scenes.title: The borrower receives the loan
scenes.copy: The co-signed LoanSet funds the borrower. Its execution receipt links this ledger result to the agreed terms.

scenes.title: The ledger enforces a boundary
scenes.copy: A 200 XRP withdrawal is refused for insufficient liquidity. The vault stays unchanged; the 12-drop transaction fee still applies.

scenes.title: The borrower repays
scenes.copy: LoanPay returns the principal and the scheduled interest to the vault.

scenes.title: The lender receives capital + yield
scenes.copy: The lender withdraws the original 200 XRP plus 20 drops of gross realised yield. Network fees are separate.
